pista.spiegazione: The rink-side tablet signs in with this club code, not with a person's account. It only opens the rink: today's sessions, attendance and notes.

pista.avviso: Regenerate the code when a tablet is lost or someone leaves the club.
pista.qr_alt: QR code to sign in the rinkside tablet
pista.qr_istruzione: Scan the QR with the tablet camera, then save the page to the home screen: from then on the tablet signs in by itself.
pista.qr_chiave: This QR code and this link work like a key: whoever has them gets into this club's rink. Regenerating the code stops every QR code and link already handed out.

costi_risorsa.label: Hourly cost CHF
costi_risorsa.nota: Leave empty if you don't know it, write 0 if you don't pay for it. It is used to calculate course margins and the yield of an hour of ice.
costi_risorsa.non_valido: Write a number, or leave it empty.
costi_risorsa.errore_lettura: Could not read the hourly costs: please try again.
costi_risorsa.nessuna_stagione: No season configured: the hourly cost belongs to a season.

step2.warning_desc: The time slots of the season you are closing are copied into the new season, day by day. The old ones stay with the old season as history. Check them in {{club_config}}: you do not have to rebuild them from scratch.
